Product Description
Powerful 4000W Motor
Experience strong acceleration and impressive climbing performance with a 60V 4000W DC brushless motor. With a top speed of up to 56 MPH, the electric moped delivers powerful torque for daily commuting, load carrying, and varied riding conditions.
60V 35Ah Long-Range Lithium Battery
Equipped with a 60V 35Ah lithium battery using Samsung battery cells, dual protection boards, and a rain-resistant metal battery case. Enjoy a riding range of over 43.5 miles on a full charge, with a dedicated lithium battery controller for stable and efficient power delivery.
Adjustable Speed Control
The intelligent controller supports 5 adjustable speed levels, allowing you to choose a comfortable riding speed for different road and riding conditions.
Hydraulic Disc Brakes & Full LED Lighting
Front and rear hydraulic disc brakes provide responsive braking performance. The lighting system includes a high/low-beam front light, front turn signals, and an integrated rear running, brake, and turn signal light for improved visibility.
Strong Frame & Adjustable DNM Suspension
The lightweight 59 kg (130 lb) frame combines strength with an ergonomic design. Adjustable DNM suspension allows rebound and compression adjustment, while the front and mid-mounted suspension system helps provide a smoother ride over uneven roads.
19" x 3" All-Terrain Tires
The 19" x 3" all-terrain tires feature a traction-focused tread pattern designed to provide grip and stability across a variety of road surfaces. The integrated seat is ergonomically shaped for added riding comfort.
3.5" Smart Color Display
The 3.5-inch IPS color display features a sunlight-readable design and IP67 water resistance. Easily monitor essential riding information, with convenient features including approach unlocking, automatic locking, multi-language support, and selectable display themes.

Built for Powerful Everyday Riding
From daily commuting to recreational riding, this 60V 4000W electric moped combines high-output performance, long-range battery power, responsive hydraulic braking, adjustable suspension, and smart controls in one capable package.
Please check your local laws and regulations regarding electric mopeds, registration, licensing, helmet requirements, and where this vehicle may legally be operated before purchase.
